name: Tempo Monk
lore: A travelling martial artist whose twelve-second bell alternates close fists and distant flame. The ring shows the current stance and the time until it changes.

primary.name: Bullet Punch / Throwing Dagger
primary.description: Melee: three fast directional jabs, 8 damage each; landing all three slows for 1s. Every 12s swap to ranged: 16-damage dagger, 420 reach, 0.8s cooldown.

secondary.name: Triple Kick / Fire Breath
secondary.description: Melee: leap between up to three foes, 14 damage and 0.7s stun each. Ranged: narrow 2s fire stream, 6 damage per 0.25s tick plus 2 burn damage each second for 3s.

special.name: Venom Discipline
special.description: For 12s enter poison stance: a close poison jab and a spinning ring of eight poison darts. Natural stance timer pauses, then resumes with a fresh 12s.

passive: Measured Breath: each natural stance change restores 4 HP.

technique.name: Heavy Discipline

attack.name: Heavy Discipline
attack.description: All stance primary attacks deal 25% more damage and recover 35% slower.

technique.description: Stronger primary attacks in every form, with a slower rhythm.

final_technique.name: Shadow Discipline

attack.name: Shadow Discipline
attack.description: For 12s enter shadow stance. Primary dashes through foes for 22 damage; secondary grants 1.5s immunity, heals 6 HP and lets you move.

final_technique.description: Replace poison stance with mobility and a short defensive veil; special recharges slower.
